newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - BHP says Griffin rebuilding oil output.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - BHP says Griffin rebuilding oil output.

text.p: The Griffin floating oil platform had reconnected and was building production back up to average daily levels, The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd said on Monday.
"It did actually reconnect ... on Friday (evening local time) and oil production recommenced on Saturday," a BHP spokesman told Reuters.
The spokesman was unable to give exact reconnection or production restart times for Griffin.
"We're in the process of production. I haven't got an exact (output) number," he added.
Production had been averaging about 60,000 barrels a day in recent weeks.
The spokesman said no cargoes were being offloaded from Griffin at the moment.
BHP shut in Griffin late on Monday one week ago as the now dissipated cyclone Rachel bore down on Western Australia's offshore fields.
BHP holds a 45 percent interest in the Griffin oil project and is the operator. Mobil Corp holds 35 percent and Inpex Alpha Ltd owns the remaining 20 percent.
